rows.ARS:
Apricot or apricot blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: MEIpraserpi
rows.Origin:
Bred by Alain Meilland (1940-....) (France, before 1979).
Introduced in France by Meilland et Cie in 1981 as 'Catherine Deneuve'.
Introduced in Australia by Ross Roses in 1985 as 'Catherine Deneuve'.
rows.Bloom: Salmon-pink. Mild to strong fragrance. 20 to 30 petals. Average diameter 5.5". Very large, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, upright. Large, glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 43" to 47" (110 to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
